# TurboTrade.ai

> TurboTrade runs ready-made algorithmic trading strategies on auto-pilot inside your own broker account, so your money stays with your broker. SEBI registered. Plans from ₹2,999 a month with no profit share.

## Pages

- [Home](https://turbotrade.ai/): what TurboTrade is, how it works and plans.
- [Broker Partner Program](https://turbotrade.ai/broker-partner-program): for brokers who want to offer TurboTrade strategies to their clients.
- [Contact](https://turbotrade.ai/contact): support, partnership and legal contacts.
